title: [GMCP 203.002.01] Contract: JSON-RPC, protocol metadata, errors, cancellation, and negotiation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-002-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: GMCP implements the complete JSON-RPC substrate for every supported revision: identifiers and batches where applicable, notifications, cancellation, progress tokens, typed standard and MCP errors, required resultType, per-request protocol/capability metadata, trace context, and deterministic unsupported-version behavior. Malformed, duplicated, reordered, oversized, and adversarial messages fail predictably without corrupting another request. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
